description: Baseline: original system-prompt.txt (~9785 chars, ~2935 est tokens). avg_ttft=1578ms, pass=17/34
Compact prompt (1417 chars) + fix tool schema injection ({{core_tools}} resolved). Removed Notes/Messages/Mail/Research/Skills sections. TTFT -75%, pass_rate +41%
Strengthened proposal rule with CRITICAL note. pass_rate 0.706→0.735 but TTFT 398→419ms (extra text). Discarding.
Ultra-compact prompt (893 chars). TTFT 398→324ms (-18% from prev best). pass_rate dropped 0.706→0.618 — less explicit proposal rule hurts accuracy
Added system action guidance. TTFT 324→364ms (+40ms worse). pass_rate 0.618→0.647 (only +1 test). Bad tradeoff. Discard.
Added 'Only use when no applicable tool exists.' constraint to direct answer. TTFT 324→320ms AND pass_rate 0.618→0.765. Win on both metrics.
Added tool_call examples (open app, search, etc.). TTFT 320→340ms + pass_rate 0.765→0.735. Both worse. Discard.
Option B hybrid: compact output rules + all domain sections trimmed (Notes/Mail/Messages/System/Skills). 2983 chars. TTFT 1578→639ms (-60%), pass_rate 0.647 (22/34). Production-safe merge target.
Baseline: merged hybrid prompt (3344 chars). avg_ttft=724ms, pass_rate=0.706 (24/34). Starting continuation session.
Over-compressed all sections — 'Tool call:' terse label + SYSTEM over-proposal hint broke both directions. 520ms but 15/34 pass (0.441). Discard.
Compact production prompt (2237 chars): exact 941-char OUTPUT FORMAT + 1-line domain sections + RESEARCH + deferred catalog vars. TTFT 724→519ms (-28%), pass_rate stable at 0.706.
Added 'Never claim to perform an action without calling a tool' constraint. pass_rate 0.706→0.824 (+12pp, 24→28 tests). TTFT 519→521ms (2ms noise). Memory moved to intro sentence.
temperature=0 (greedy). TTFT unchanged (521ms, as expected — TTFT is prefill-only). pass_rate 0.824→0.794. No benefit. Reverted temperature to 0.7.
Aggressive compression: compact intro, removed ISO from CONTEXT, RULES→1 line, tighter domain sections. 1858 chars. TTFT 521→460ms (-12%), pass_rate 0.824→0.765 (still ≥0.75).
Restored 'You are Ora' persona format. Fixed calendar-query/contacts-search 'error' cases from prev run. TTFT 460→458ms (noise). pass_rate 0.765 stable.
Tool schemas: show only required params (drop ':str' type + omit optionals). TTFT 458→448ms AND pass_rate 0.765→0.882 (26→30 tests). Double win.
Multiple simultaneous changes. Pass_rate crashed 0.882→0.618. Likely intro removed capability list ('calendar, reminders, contacts...'). 439ms TTFT but unacceptable accuracy. Discard.
30-char desc cap: TTFT 448→446ms (noise), pass_rate 0.882→0.794. Shorter descriptions hurt accuracy. Now trying no-description schema: name + required params only.
No descriptions in tool schemas (name + required params only). TTFT 448→434ms (-3%), max_ttft 640→520ms. pass_rate 0.882→0.794 (still ≥0.75). Descriptions were adding noise.
No-description schema: open_settings/open_app got JSON errors without 'Open System Settings to...' context. 3 new failures. Reverting to 52-char desc + required-params-only (the run #16 sweet spot).
Production SystemPromptBuilder updated to required-params-only encoding. ISO restored to CONTEXT. Tests updated. TTFT 448→446ms, pass_rate 0.882→0.824 (variance at temp=0.7, still >0.75).
